name: dsh
notes: PARTIALLY VERIFIED, and it matters which parts. Verified from dsh's own documentation and source: the harness home is $DSH_HOME or ~/.dsh and holds the fixed user-global AGENTS.md; plugins are Cordis modules mounted explicitly (dsh does NOT auto-load an extensions directory); the tool pipeline exposes `tools/pre-execute`, and the built-in filesystem tools are named read/write/edit with a `file_path` argument. NOT verified: where a user-global MCP declaration lives (dsh resolves MCP servers per session/adapter, and this project refuses to write to a guessed path), and whether dsh reads ~/.agents/skills. Because of that this manifest declares only the parts that were checked, and `doctor` keeps reporting the target as unverified until someone confirms it against a real installation.

managed.note: the fixed user-global instruction file, per config-catalog (dshHome + AGENTS.md)

gates.mount_hint:
dsh mounts plugins through a Cordis composition, so the installed directory does not take effect until a plugin row points at it. Add to your cordis patch:

  - name: '~/.dsh/plugins/agent-config-gates/'
    config:
      policyPath: '~/.dsh/plugins/agent-config-gates/policy.json'

`status` reports whether the gate directory is installed; whether it is mounted is visible only in your own composition file, which this project deliberately does not edit.
